availability.note: CarsGuide new-car listing '2026 Mercedes-Benz EQA 250+ H243 MY27', status 'New: Available to order', RRP $86,700. mercedes-benz.com.au (configurator, model and offer pages) returned HTTP 403 to automated reads, so the manufacturer configurator could not be opened; carsales 2026 research page lists the EQA250+ as current.

listPrice.note: CarExpert: 'prices starting at $86,700' before on-road costs, released 3 Jan 2026; matches CarsGuide MY27 listing RRP $86,700 and CarsGuide 2026/2027 EQA price pages (MSRP, excludes stamp duty and government charges). Up from $85,800. Manufacturer price list unreachable (403). Vic drive-away via calc/onroad.js = $91,221.

batteryKwh.note: usable 70.5 kWh, nominal/gross 73.9 kWh on the same page; CarExpert AU spec also lists 70.5 kWh usable

rangeKm.note: UK EQA 250+ AMG Line Premium on 20-inch 235/45 R20 wheels (same wheel/tyre as the AU car), WLTP combined 520 km. Held AU figure 578 km rejected by the direction test: it exceeds Mercedes' WLTP best case of 560 km (EV Database TEL; CarExpert 2024 launch story '496km to 560km' WLTP), and CarsGuide labels 578 km NEDC.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: WLTP combined 15.7 kWh/100km for the same 20-inch variant; battery/range = 13.6, 15.8% apart (wall-to-wheel includes charging loss), inside the 25% tolerance

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: VDA, to the lower window edge (cargo-cover convention)

towKg.note: AU spec 750 kg braked; UK/EU data (Auto Express, EV Database) give 1,500 kg. Mercedes AU technical sheet unreachable (403).

warrantyYears.note: 60 months, unlimited km, whole vehicle; battery 96 months/160,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: kept at held value; anchored to bmw-ix1-xdrive30-m-sport ($86,800, 2300), audi-q4-e-tron-55-quattro ($81,650, 2400) and mercedes-cla-ev-200-eq ($72,200, 1950)

depreciationCurve.note: steeper than mainstream default: outgoing model replaced by the electric GLA in 2027 (CarExpert 30 Jul 2026, Chasing Cars 29 Jul 2026), and carsales shows new 2026 EQA250+ dealer stock at $65,490 indicative drive-away against an $86,700 RRP. Same curve as the held EQA data; other Mercedes rows differ (mercedes-cla-ev [1,0.72,...], mercedes-gla-phev [1,0.7,0.59,...]), so no single brand convention exists yet.
